title: Elephant random walk with attributed steps and extractions of random sizes
summary: We study a model of market economics wherein the $(n+1)$-st customer, for each $n\geqslant N$, with $N$ being a prespecified positive integer, draws a sample of (random) size $K_{n}$, either with replacement or without, from the customers of the past. Each sampled customer is queried as to which of the two products, A and B, available in the oligopolistic market, they chose, and whether they are satisfied or not with their choice. The $(n+1)$-st customer now employs a stochastic rule, based on the information collected from the sampled customers, to decide which of the two products to buy.…
